special_family_result: f_0+az is onto exactly when (2 Re a-1)^3 < 27(Im a)^2; otherwise it omits exactly -conjugate(a)
uniform_bounded_perturbation_result: For this f_0, every holomorphic h of supremum norm strictly less than 3/64 preserves surjectivity
remaining_gap: No good bounded univalent perturbation is constructed for an arbitrary holomorphic disk surjection, and no counterexample to that existential question is established
verification_scope: 1,021 exact finite algebraic assertions, not formal verification of the analytic proofs or the universal problem
